programs.title: Retro Mix
programs.desc: A mix of 70's, 80's & 90's hits featuring the classics you remember and then some.

programs.title: The 80's
programs.desc: The start of the music video era, with 80's classics not to be forgotten as well as some you probably have forgotten (for good reason!).

programs.title: The 90's
programs.desc: Britpop, Jamming basslines, Catchy pop, forgotten boy bands with a bit of hip hop. It's the 90's baby.

programs.title: The 00's
programs.desc: A mix of the hits of 2000's along with some more lesser known artists.

programs.title: Vantage Yearbook
programs.desc: See the the most common faces in music from a specific year.
